description: This file is a script for generating dummy user data, including users, accounts, cards, transfers, messages, and statistics, for testing or seeding a Strapi-based backend.

methods.name: getDefaultUserData
methods.description: Generates default user data with randomized fields using faker, including username, email, name, date of birth, phone, address, and postcode.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in the database with randomized data.

methods.name: createControlledUser
methods.description: Creates a specific user with a fixed email for testing purposes.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a bank account associated with a user, with randomized account details.

methods.name: createCard
methods.description: Creates a card linked to an account and user, with randomized card details.

methods.name: createTransfer
methods.description: Creates a transfer record between accounts with randomized details.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message for a user with randomized content.

methods.name: createStats
methods.description: Creates or updates statistical data (income and expenses) for an account.

methods.name: generateData
methods.description: Generates multiple accounts, cards, transfers, stats, and messages for a user with delays to simulate real-time data creation.
